blocks.text: Spectroscopy maadde ke saath electromagnetic radiation ke amal se paida hone wale spectra ke banane, napne aur samajhne se mutaliq hai. Spectrum atomic aur molecular tawanai ki satahon, molecules ki shakal, molecules ke darmiyan amal aur kimiyai bonds ki noiyat ki maloomat deta hai. Spectroscopic paimaish sample mein kisi maadde ki miqdar bhi nap sakti hai (quantitative analysis) ya sirf na-maloom sample pehchan sakti hai (qualitative analysis).

Kisi maadde ki kimiyai banawat emission aur absorption spectra se parhi ja sakti hai. Har unsar spectral lakeeron ka anokha namoona deta hai, ungli ke nishan ki tarah, is liye anasir apne atomic spectra se pehchane ja sakte hain. Hydrogen 656 nm par tez surkh lakeer deta hai; jalta sodium 589 nm ki tez lakeeron se khaas peela shola deta hai; mercury ki zyada tar emission lakeerein 450 nm se neeche hain, jo khaas neeli roshni deti hain.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Atomic spectra falkiyat dano ko sitaron ki kimiyai banawat maloom karne mein madad dete hain: in ajram ki chhori roshni ka tajziya kar ke scientists bata sakte hain ke in mein kaun se anasir hain.

blocks.prompt: Kisi unsar ko us ke emission spectrum se kyun pehchana ja sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Har unsar ki apni tawanai ki satahein hain, is liye us ki spectral lakeeron ka namoona anokha hai, ungli ke nishan ki tarah.

items: Spectroscopy radiation aur maadde ke amal ka mutala.
Line spectra anasir ke ungli ke nishan (H 656 nm, Na 589 nm).
